recipient_context: The draft is addressed to Dr. Ilse Vantongeren, Casimir's line manager and station lead, who is on research leave until 6 February. Her out-of-office names Dr. Halina Brzezicka as delegate for scientific decisions only and states explicitly that she is not covering procurement.

data_a.organization: Tern Hollow Field Station, a coastal ornithology research station.
data_a.manager: Dr. Ilse Vantongeren, station lead and Casimir's line manager.
situation_facts: Casimir needs two autonomous acoustic recorders and matching solar kits, totalling three thousand one hundred and eighty euros.
Station policy allows the line manager to approve purchases up to one thousand euros.
Purchases above one thousand euros go to the facilities and procurement director, Yannick Ostrowski, on the standard PR-2 form.
Dr. Ilse Vantongeren is on research leave until 6 February.
Ilse's out-of-office names Dr. Halina Brzezicka as delegate for scientific decisions only and states she is not covering procurement.
Yannick Ostrowski's stated PR-2 turnaround is fifteen working days.
The recorders must be installed on site before the nightjar survey opens on 1 March.
Supplier lead time on the recorders is three weeks from order.
Fifteen working days from 8 January plus three weeks supplier lead time lands in mid-February, which still clears 1 March, but any delay in submitting the form does not.
Casimir has not previously submitted a PR-2 and has been sending purchase requests to Ilse informally for two years.

ownership_map.purchases above one thousand euros: Yannick Ostrowski, facilities and procurement director

turns.input_raw: Purchase request, same as I always do. "Hi Ilse - can you approve two acoustic recorders and solar kits for the nightjar survey? Comes to three thousand one hundred and eighty euros all in. I need them on site before 1 March so ideally we order this week. Let me know and I will raise it with the supplier. Casimir"
